notes: Read-only triage of 85 uncited docs/evidence/ documents (my own scan — see method). 5 ABSORB, 26 EXEMPT, 54 REJECT. Two ABSORB units, both verified by opening every cited source: (1) GLOBAL.CORRECTIONS/{PROVENANCE,cross-check-2026-07-28}.md + GLOBAL.SESSION-CHOOSE/{PROVENANCE,audit-2026-07-28}.md — EXP-14 (2026-07-28) and EXP-16 (2026-07-28) jointly prove ADR-0013's Consequences bullet ('the GTP player shares this machinery; it inherits the fix automatically') is FALSE — Session.choose (src/gtp.zig:184) is a one-ply table lookup with no import of retro.zig/solve.zig. This is independently corroborated (docs/audits/2026-07-28-muhtasib-audit-chunk2.md:48) and already flagged operationally in docs/status/HANDOVER.md's Gotchas section, but the register (CLAIMS.md) has NO row for it — '4x4.GTP-DEFECT' is cited as a *dependent* by other rows (e.g. 4x4.B16-GAME) but no row of that ID exists. This is a dangling-claim-ID gap (register talks about a claim it never defines), not a contradiction of a live row, but it is exactly the kind of silent gap T372 was. (2) c2-3x2/B10-minimax.md — a 2026-07-26 rescued probe explicitly self-flagged 'UNCITED... do not treat as evidence until a committed document cites it'. Its finding (47/455 = 10.3% of sampled ko-sensitive (position,side,history) triples have the history-aware value OUTSIDE the stored [L,H] bracket at 3x2, max|diff|=12 even at bracket-width 3) is a POINTWISE falsification of C3 at 3x2 — the same T13-vs-E2 outcome/pointwise distinction the QA-018 panel (already-cited, unanimous SOUND) established for 3x2 C2. The LIVE register row `3x2.C3` currently reads only 'Range-aware player leak-free at 3x2 (0/4000 games)' | MEASUREMENT — an OUTCOME-level reading that gives no hint C3 is pointwise-violated 1-in-10 times at the same goban. This is the sharpest finding: a live row whose text would read very differently if it cited this document. Caveat carried forward: B10's sampling is a single random walk per (position,side) with a root-queried (not tail-queried) methodology, weaker than T13's; the follow-on absorption row should re-derive or at least re-run B10's harness before promoting any CLAIMS.md status change — the ABSORB is 'cite and reconcile', not 'promote as-is'.
triage_method: Reconstructed the 56-scale population independently rather than reading the other lanes' output (race rule, ruling 7c.35): diffed all non-README .md files under docs/evidence/ (141) against every path cited by docs/epistemic/CLAIMS.md (backtick spans, including directory-level citations) using a python script. Got 85 uncited candidates, not the stated 56 — the gap is almost entirely two categories the other lane(s) likely excluded a priori: docs/evidence/EPISTEMIC-RACES/packets/ (19 files, self-contained exam material for the model-bakeoff harness) and docs/evidence/RESCUED-tmp-2026-08-08/t408/ (5 files, one-line mechanical fleet-capacity probes) — both EXEMPT by inspection, not evidence for any Z-tree claim. Net of those 24, my count is 61, still 5 above 56; the remainder is ordinary lane variance (T672/T673/T674/T676 will each report a slightly different denominator by design — 'your own honest 56', not a fixed set). Ordering used: opened every document; for each, searched CLAIMS.md (and, where the doc named one, the specific row) for the claim it bears on; prioritized write-up by (a) whether it contradicts a *live, currently-cited* row's stated content [B10-minimax → 3x2.C3; the GTP-DEFECT pair → the dangling ID], (b) whether it duplicates/extends an already-well-cited finding [most ORACLE-V2/QA-018/GLOBAL.* build-history docs — REJECT], (c) whether it is structurally out-of-scope for CLAIMS.md by design [race-harness exam packets, mechanical fleet probes, landmark-tracking docs like T401/T407/T366/T509/T389 which explicitly say 'no register claims' and are tracked instead in docs/status/landmark-assignment-2026-08-19.md and docs/audits/2026-08-05-handover/LANDMARKS.md]. Did not rule ABSORB on anything not opened; did not read T670/T672/T673/T674/T676's findings or briefs (race isolation).

shape_of_findings: 50 of 54 REJECTs are benign for the same handful of reasons, not 50 independent judgment calls: (i) ~30 are 2026-07-28..08-02 build/debug/audit history for the WZO1/WZO2/oracle-v2 pipeline and the QA-018 bracket-cut panel — every defect they found was fixed or superseded by later commits, and the QA-018 panel's unanimous verdict is already narrated near-verbatim inside GLOBAL.ADR0015-BURDEN's row text (just not path-cited — a citation-hygiene gap, not a contradiction); (ii) ~10 are docs/research/*.md prose-hygiene audits (denominator sweeps, hypothesis reality-checks) that propose fixes to docs/research/, never to CLAIMS.md; (iii) ~8 are same-day (2026-08-20..22) work already flowing through the normal findings/*.json → absorption pipeline (T571, T625, GLOBAL.REACH-P4-CENSUS, I11-4x4-EXHAUSTIVE) — correctly unabsorbed-in-progress, not silently lost; (iv) a genuine larger pattern worth stating as its own finding: at least 6 evidence documents (T366, T509, T389, and the two BRACKET-TOURNAMENT docs, T407) are the primary evidence for landmarks L2/L3 and explicitly self-declare 'no register claims' — this is a deliberate, consistent design choice (engine-quality/landmark tracking lives in docs/status/landmark-assignment-2026-08-19.md and LANDMARKS.md, not in the Z-tree register), not an absorption gap, but it does mean CLAIMS.md is structurally silent on 'is the new engine actually better', which a reader of CLAIMS.md alone would not know to go looking for elsewhere. Estimate of uncited documents outside docs/evidence/: likely large and systematically undercounted by any docs/evidence/-scoped scan — docs/research/*.md (37 files, T110/EXP-12's own denominator sweep treats these as a citable corpus in their own right and found their *numbers* mostly self-consistent, but citation TO them from CLAIMS.md is sparse: `leak-crisis.md`, `c2-falsification-3x2.md` and a handful of others are the only research/ files CLAIMS.md's evidence column names directly) plus docs/decisions/*.md (append-only ADRs, several — 0006, 0007, 0013 — carry known-stale or known-false clauses per this very triage, cited by prose elsewhere but not by CLAIMS.md path) plus docs/audits/*.md (dozens, mostly narrated-not-cited). A rough floor: 15-30 more in docs/decisions+docs/research alone, i.e. the true population of 'the register doesn't cite this but something it says depends on it' is plausibly 2-3x the 85 found in docs/evidence/ alone. This should be its own follow-on scan, not folded into this row's count.
